person.name: Ada Example
person.headline: Backend engineer building reliable edge and data systems
person.summary: Fictional demo profile. Ada ships backend services, device fleet tooling and developer tools, and keeps every claim on this page tied to evidence.

highlights: Own the firmware rollout service for a fleet of edge AI devices
Mentor two engineers on testing and code review
Built ingestion pipelines for sensor data

projects.name: Fleet Updater
projects.description: Parallel firmware rollout for edge devices over unreliable field networks.

story.problem: Firmware updates were run device by device over SSH, took hours per site and occasionally bricked devices when power dropped mid-update.
story.responsibility: Designed and built the updater end to end; ran the first three site rollouts.
story.approach: One worker per device with retry-until-reachable semantics, and a narrow, explicitly guarded critical section for the rename step.
story.implementation: Python, Paramiko, a CSV-driven queue that accepts new devices while running, and structured logs per device.
story.outcome: Rollouts run unattended per site; the risky step is isolated and logged.

projects.name: Log Lens
projects.description: Open-source parser that turns raw device logs into searchable timelines.

story.problem: Support engineers grepped multi-gigabyte logs by hand to reconstruct incidents.
story.approach: Stream parsing with typed event records and a small query layer.
story.outcome: Used by the support team for incident timelines.
